title: SAT Practice Score Plateau
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=khan:sat score_delta=* skill_name=*
| bin _time span=2w
| stats avg(score_delta) as avg_score_delta by _time skill_name
| where avg_score_delta<=0.5
| sort 0 skill_name _time
description: Highlights SAT skills whose average score movement has flattened out over a two-week window.
value: Plateaus are where new study tactics matter most, because more of the same effort is no longer buying progress.
implementation: Ingest Khan Academy practice results with per-skill score deltas and review low-growth windows by skill.
visualization: Heat map or line chart of score-delta trend by skill.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which SAT areas have stopped improving and may need a different study approach.
